data.text/markdown:
A certified resource ledger shows where ZX rewriting pays on Quantinuum H2

Team Learned ZX Rewriting, Quantinuum Singapore Grand Challenge, submission 1. This notebook is the executable companion of report/report_v1.md. It
  1. loads the result tables from results/*.csv and shows them with the figures,
  2. compiles one chosen circuit live through the baseline P0 (pytket level 2) and through P2 (PyZX teleport_reduce followed by P0),
  3. submits the compiled circuits to the H2-2E emulator through aqora.QPU, gated behind a run button.
Every number shown here is read from the CSV files or computed in the cell that shows it. Nothing is typed in.

1. Result tables

Columns follow pipelines/compile.py:metrics. n_2q is the ZZPhase plus ZZMax count of the compiled native circuit, hqc is the HQC estimate at 1000 shots.

data.text/html: Table A1. Family A, mean ZZPhase count by n and pipeline.
Table A2. Family A, pipelines against P0, 180 circuits.
Table B1. Family B1, ZZPhase count per circuit and pipeline. Empty cells are timeouts (hwb8 under P1 and P2).
Table B2. Family B2, means over 5 circuits per (n, eps, pipeline).

Table A4. Local density-matrix noise proxy with the published H2-2E default parameters (results/family_A_proxy_h22e.csv), mean Hellinger fidelity by n and pipeline. To be replaced by H2-2E emulator results. [PENDING: emulator]
Table C. Certified T-count floor (lde of the exact Pauli channel) against the T-count after the ZX stage of P2, 24 rows. Invariant floor <= T_zx violated on 0 rows.

Table S. Selene noiseless runs of the compiled circuits, 468 runs of 2000 shots, sampled distribution against the exact one (results/selene_noiseless.csv). flagged counts runs with TVD above 4 times the sampling scale.

Table M. Learned cost model, y = -ln F_H from compile-time features, fitted on the proxy CSVs. lofo trains on one family and tests on the other, cv5g holds out whole circuit classes. Emulator rows replace the proxy rows once they exist. [PENDING: emulator]

data.text/markdown:
3. Submission to the H2-2E emulator

aqora.QPU submits programs exactly as given, so the circuits are rebased by the pipeline above and measured here. Jobs are attributed to the team organization through as_entity. The noisy_simulation option selects the emulator's noise model. Press the button to submit. Nothing is sent before that.
